tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card. A cool near-black in dark, never #000, so card borders and shadows still read.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, the sidebar and table headers (sticky headers repeat it so rows slide under cleanly).

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. Same value as foreground; kept for the shadcn Card primitive.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: One step above card: hover rows, segmented-control tracks, the sidebar's data box, inline code.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a segmented control (MaTabs, range toggle), lifted with shadow-thumb.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Tooltips (charts and the distribution) and any floating menu; pair with shadow-pop.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn's hover surface: secondary-button hover. Not a brand colour despite the name.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and headline figures. 14.3:1 or better on background, card, raised and popover in both themes.

tokens.name: foreground-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, tile sub-lines, nav items at rest, axis category labels. 7.1:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: labels, column heads, axis ticks, keyboard hints. 4.6:1 or better on every surface in both themes, so it stays body-legible.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table rules, dividers. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The 50% reference line on the breadth chart and other rules that must survive over a fill.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text-entry borders (the date field). 3.2:1 or better against card and background in both themes, so the field is findable.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid outline, offset 2px. 4.6:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: the breadth series and other single-series charts, the active nav item's icon, today's bin, the primary button, focus. As text, 4.6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark ink in the dark theme, because the lightened brand fails with white (2.97:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand text: the active nav item, the brand badge, the wordmark tile.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Above the average, improving. Fills, dots and signed values. As text, 5.4:1 or better on every surface. Always paired with a sign, arrow or word.

tokens.name: up-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind up text in badges ("Above", the count pill). up on up-soft is 8.2:1 dark, 5.3:1 light.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Below the average, deteriorating. Fills, dots and signed values. As text, 4.8:1 or better on every surface. Differs from up in lightness too (colour-blind ΔE 14.0 dark, 9.2 light).

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind down text in badges. down on down-soft is 4.6:1 dark, 4.8:1 light.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines: hairline, solid, horizontal only on time series.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The single series in every chart (breadth area, crossings bars). An alias, so a brand change moves the charts.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Context marks and empty tracks: the distribution's other bins, meter and range tracks, distance-bar tracks.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn primary: the default Button fill.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn secondary: the secondary Button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn muted: same as raised.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn destructive. This product has no destructive actions; it resolves to down.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Standalone numbers use Geist's default proportional figures; only columns of numbers switch to tabular.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one headline figure per page (today's breadth in BreadthHero). Its % sign drops to 45% size in muted-foreground.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Stat-tile values. A trailing unit (%, pts) is 13px medium at 70% opacity.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Sentence case everywhere except eyebrows and table heads.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title in PageHeader. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: How many of the fifty constituents close above their moving average.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: of NIFTY 50 constituents closed above their 200-day SMA
styles.usage: Page descriptions, nav items, buttons, table cells (symbols at 600).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tile sub-lines, card descriptions, footnotes, status lines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in UPPERCASE. Page eyebrows, the hero's kicker, sidebar section labels.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Set in UPPERCASE, muted-foreground. Table column heads only.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono is for keys, dates typed into fields and code. Never for figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Inline code, the date input, shortcut keys in the sidebar.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hint chips beside nav items and segments.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Card padding is space-5, gaps between cards space-4.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: The surface gap between touching fills (split bar, histogram bins) and inside segmented tracks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Small gaps: segment label to its kbd, control groups.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Nav-item padding and icon gap; distance bar to its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell side padding; tile gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and tiles; stat-tile padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and card-header side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero padding from sm up; page gutter from sm; header-to-content gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter and top padding from lg.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd chips and inline code.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls nested inside a radius-md track: segments, stepper buttons, the date field, the Go button (rounded-[8px] in code).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented-control tracks, nav items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Reserved for a future large surface; unused today.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, meters, the split bar, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and stat tile. In dark, a 1px top highlight does the lifting a shadow cannot.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltips and anything floating.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected segment.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The fixed sidebar from lg (w-60); the content column pads by the same amount.

tokens.name: content-max-width
tokens.usage: The content column's cap.

tokens.name: table-max-height
tokens.usage: Member tables scroll inside their card past this (crossings table: 560px).
